title: Home Tuition Platform
description: One-to-One online coaching platform for competitive exam aspirants with live sessions, token-based payments, and auto-scheduling.
longDescription: Built a complete web-based coaching platform designed for competitive exam aspirants (SSC, Banking, Railway). The platform supports one-to-one live sessions between students and verified tutors, with a full token-based payment system, auto-scheduling, and real-time video/chat.
problem: Competitive exam aspirants needed a reliable platform for one-to-one coaching with verified tutors, but existing solutions lacked integrated payments, auto-scheduling, and proper session management. Manual KYC verification was a bottleneck.
solution: Developed a comprehensive platform with OTP-based authentication and auto KYC verification using Aadhaar & PAN. Implemented a token wallet system where students buy tokens and book sessions that can be extended in 15-minute blocks. Real-time 1:1 video classes using Socket.IO with auto-recording, and smart scheduling that auto-creates weekly class schedules when students purchase packages.
results: Auto KYC verification eliminates manual admin approval step
Token-based system enables flexible session booking and extensions
Real-time video sessions with automatic recording for every class
Smart scheduling automatically creates weekly timetables
Role-based dashboards for Students, Tutors, and Admin
Integrated payment processing with Razorpay/Stripe including TDS handling

title: PostClub Social Media
description: Full-featured social media platform with real-time chat, post management, and user engagement features.
longDescription: Built and deployed a full-stack social media platform enabling users to create accounts, share posts, like/comment, and engage in real-time one-on-one chats. Features secure authentication, responsive UI, and scalable backend architecture.
problem: Users needed a modern, fast social media platform that combines content sharing with real-time communication. Traditional social platforms often have complex UIs and slow performance.
solution: Created a streamlined social media experience with JWT-based secure authentication. Users can create, update, and delete posts with text and media. Integrated one-on-one messaging using Socket.IO for instant communication. Built responsive UI with React and Tailwind CSS, and developed RESTful APIs with Node.js & Express.js for scalable data handling.
results: Secure authentication system using JWT tokens
Full CRUD operations for posts with media support
Efficient MongoDB database for user profiles, posts, and chat history

title: Video Library Platform
description: YouTube-style video library with playlist management, categories, and user engagement features.
longDescription: Built a responsive and user-friendly video library allowing users to browse, watch, and organize videos by categories and likes, simulating a YouTube-style experience with custom playlists and history tracking.
problem: Users needed an organized way to browse, watch, and manage video content with features like playlists, likes, and viewing history, similar to popular video platforms.
solution: Developed a full-stack video library with video browsing featuring thumbnails and metadata. Implemented playlist management allowing users to create, edit, and delete custom playlists. Added like and history features to save videos. Included search functionality to filter videos by category, all with a mobile-first responsive design.
results: Intuitive video browsing with thumbnails and metadata
Like and history tracking for personalized experience
